design_description: A stealth-inspired black-on-black design with a premium luxury aesthetic and strong streetwear influence. The jersey features a large tonal dragon illustration wrapping across the lower torso, adding depth and aggression while remaining subtle through dark monochrome detailing. Gold crown elements and minimalist KINGS branding reinforce the elite, high-status identity, while the thin shoulder stripes and clean composition keep the overall look sleek and modern. The contrast between the dark dragon artwork and the bright sponsor logos creates a powerful balance between elegance and intensity.
